The '''GL-77 blaster pistol''' was a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] used during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was a small, yet powerful blaster pistol that fired high-pitched blaster bolts.

[[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of [[Pantora/Legends|Pantora]], [[Chi Cho/Legends|Chi Cho]] and his guards utilized these blaster pistols at the [[Battle of Orto Plutonia/Legends|Battle of Orto Plutonia]], where he lost his life to the [[Talz/Legends|Talz]]. His successor, [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his [[Ion Papanoida/Legends|son]], also used these weapons in a barfight in a [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].

The [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|Bounty hunter]] [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich]] also used one, as did members of the [[Ohnaka Gang/Legends|Ohnaka Gang]].
